Term appears only in Steinberg marketing (Cubase 6 era) and user-forum posts; the current Cubase/Nuendo operation manual documents no feature by the name 'Phase-Coherent AudioWarp' and in fact states that AudioWarp quantizing does not maintain phase coherence, so the exact named feature and its behavior cannot be confirmed in the official manual. Phase-coherent multitrack editing is documented under Group Editing, but that is a distinct term.

No command named 'Consolidate regions' exists in the official Logic Pro User Guide. Logic combines/renders selected regions into a single unit via the Join command (joining audio regions creates a nondestructive mixdown audio file); 'Consolidate' is Pro Tools terminology, not a Logic feature. Cannot confirm the term as a Logic-specific command as required by the accuracy rule.
